summary: Vista Credit Strategic Lending Corp., a Maryland BDC, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing its regular monthly distribution for September 2026. Class I shares receive a gross $0.15000 per share with no servicing fee, while Class S shares receive $0.15000 gross less a $0.01346 distribution fee, netting $0.13654. The record date is the open of business September 30, 2026, with payment on or about October 26, 2026, in cash or reinvested via the DRIP. No Class D shares were outstanding. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation.
